Bonds.Title: Bonds
Bonds.SectorPlaceholder: Don't trust, owe us a favour…
Bonds.DragHint: Drag a portrait onto the wheel: each person goes to their folder's slice; the ring you drop on sets the distance. Closer to the centre, closer to you.
Bonds.AllPlaced: Everyone you know is on the wheel.
Bonds.NobodyKnownGM: Nothing revealed to this player yet.
Bonds.EmptyWheel: Drag someone onto the wheel to start
Bonds.RecordHint: Saves how every player's wheel and every status look right now, so the table can look back later.
Bonds.NoMoments: Record a moment at the end of a session to build the timeline.
Bonds.DeleteMomentConfirm: Delete the moment "{label}"? Players lose this point in their timeline.
Bonds.NewCategoryDrop: Drop here to create a category of your own
Bonds.TakeOffDrop: Drop here to take off the wheel
Bonds.DissolveHint: Dissolving sends its people back to their folders' slices. A category disappears on its own when nobody is left in it.
Bonds.SubPlayer: Click someone to see their bonds. Drag portraits to arrange the wheel.
Bonds.SubGM: You're editing {name}'s wheel. The player sees your changes.
Bonds.SubPast: As it was at {label}. Go back to now to make changes.
Bonds.NoBondsYet: No bonds yet. Link them to someone to show how they relate.
Bonds.SuspectHint: You think so, but aren't sure yet. Drawn as a dashed line.
Bonds.OfficialHint: Shows on every wheel that knows both people. Players can't change it.
Bonds.HiddenHint: Only you see it, until you untick this.
Bonds.InSceneHint: Only the people with a token on the current scene
Bonds.Export: Save the wheel as an image
Bonds.ExportFailed: Couldn't save the image: a portrait comes from another site that doesn't allow it.
Bonds.OverviewHint: Every person the players know, and where each player keeps them. Click a cell to open that wheel on that person.
Bonds.OverviewEmpty: No one has been revealed to the players yet.
Bonds.ArchiveHint: Takes them off the wheel and out of the list, but keeps them in the timeline.
Bonds.NoChangesInMoment: Nothing changed on this wheel in this moment.

Arrange.Hint: Drag to reorder or move to another folder
